# Varroa Mites

Varroa mites are the biggest threat to the colonies.

- Count mites monthly with a sugar roll of 300 bees; act above 3 mites per 100.
- Winter treatment: oxalic acid dribble when the colony is broodless.
- Summer treatment: formic acid strips after the main flow.
- Record every mite count per hive so trends are visible.
